Automate the guest through the host display.

```text
pomme ui SUBCOMMAND
```

## pomme ui type

Type text into the guest display.

```text
pomme ui type [ARGUMENTS ...] [--text TEXT] [--text-env TEXT_ENV] [--replace] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ARGUMENTS` | [VM name] text. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when the VM name is omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--text TEXT` | Text to type. |
| `--text-env TEXT_ENV` | Environment variable containing text to type. |
| `--replace` | Press Command-A before typing so the text replaces the focused field's contents. Off by default. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui key

Press a guest key. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when the VM is omitted.

```text
pomme ui key [ARGUMENTS ...] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ARGUMENTS` | [VM name] key. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when the VM name is omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui key-sequence

Press a sequence of guest keys. Use `--vm` when `POMME_VM_NAME` makes the first value ambiguous.

```text
pomme ui key-sequence [--vm VM] [ARGUMENTS ...] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ARGUMENTS` | [VM name] key...; with `POMME_VM_NAME`, use `--vm` for a multiple-key sequence that could begin with a VM name. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--vm VM` | VM name for an unambiguous key sequence. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui keys

List the key names accepted by ui key and ui key-sequence.

```text
pomme ui keys [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui click

Click guest display coordinates.

```text
pomme ui click [NAME] --x X --y Y [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--x X` | Display x coordinate in points, from the left edge. |
| `--y Y` | Display y coordinate in points, from the top edge. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui screenshot

Capture the guest display.

```text
pomme ui screenshot [NAME] --output OUTPUT [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json] [--format FORMAT] [--debug] [--progress PROGRESS]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `NAME` | VM name. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--output OUTPUT` | Host output file path. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).

## pomme ui ai

Run guided UI automation. Currently unavailable without a guest accessibility bridge.

```text
pomme ui ai SUBCOMMAND
```

### pomme ui ai settings

Navigate System Settings toward a goal. Currently unavailable without a guest accessibility bridge.

```text
pomme ui ai settings [FLAGS] [ARGUMENTS ...]
```

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `ARGUMENTS` | [VM name] goal. Uses `POMME_VM_NAME` when the VM name is omitted. |

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--mode MODE` | suggest proposes one action, step performs one, loop repeats up to `--max-steps`. Values: `suggest`, `step`, `loop`. Default: `suggest`. |
| `--max-steps MAX_STEPS` | Most actions a loop run performs. Default: `8`. |
| `--confidence CONFIDENCE` | Minimum model confidence, from 0 to 1, required to act. Default: `0.7`. |
| `--model-timeout MODEL_TIMEOUT` | Seconds to wait for each model answer. Default: `60.0`. |
| `--deterministic-fallback` | Fall back to text-matching navigation when the model is unavailable. Off by default. |
| `--no-open` | Use the window already on screen instead of opening System Settings first. |
| `--settings-url SETTINGS_URL` | x-apple.systempreferences URL to open first. Defaults to System Settings' main window. |
| `--until-text UNTIL_TEXT` | Stop once this text is visible on screen. Unset by default. |
| `--screenshot-output SCREENSHOT_OUTPUT` | Host directory for per-step screenshots. Defaults to a new temporary directory. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Time limit in seconds. |

This command also accepts the [common flags](/reference/cli/#common-flags).
